title: MILP the Gap: An Automated Reasoning Approach to Condorcet's Paradox
abstract: arXiv:2604.19851v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Computational social choice studies how conflicting individual preferences are aggregated into a collective decision, with applications to elections, AI evaluation/alignment, and recommendation systems. We focus on settings where $n$ voters (e.g., human evaluators or algorithmic benchmarks) each rank $m$ alternatives (e.g., human candidates or AI models/outputs), and the goal is to select a committee of $k$ alternatives. One measure of the (in)stability of the outcome is the number of voters who prefer an unchosen alternative to all alternatives in the committee. If this number is less than half the electorate, the committee is a Condorcet winning set, which may not exist if $k \leq 2$. More generally, there exist instances where any committee of size $k$ has at least a $\frac{2}{(k+1)}-\epsilon$ fraction of the electorate preferring another alternative, for arbitrarily small $\epsilon$. translated_title: MILP 弥合差距：孔多塞悖论的自动推理方法
translated_abstract: 计算社会选择研究如何将相互冲突的个人偏好聚合为集体决策，其应用涵盖选举、人工智能评估/对齐以及推荐系统。我们关注如下场景：$n$ 个投票者（例如人类评估者或算法基准）各自对 $m$ 个备选项（例如人类候选人或 AI 模型/输出）进行排序，目标是选出一个包含 $k$ 个备选项的委员会。衡量结果（不）稳定性的一个指标是：有多少投票者更偏好某个未被选中的备选项而非委员会中的所有备选项。如果这一人数少于选民的一半，则该委员会是一个孔多塞胜出集（Condorcet winning set）；当 $k \leq 2$ 时，这样的集合可能并不存在。更一般地，存在这样的实例：对于任意小的 $\epsilon$，任何规模为 $k$ 的委员会都至少有 $\frac{2}{(k+1)}-\epsilon$ 比例的选民更偏好另一个备选项。尽管近期的工作已经取得了显著的进……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出基于混合整数线性规划（MILP）的自动推理方法，用于自动构建并分析委员会选择中的孔多塞悖论实例，从而精确刻画委员会结果稳定性的界限。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a MILP-based automated reasoning approach to automatically construct and analyze instances of Condorcet's paradox in committee selection, precisely characterizing the limits of committee outcome stability.
